checks: Read and hash raw journal, registry and local signed-receipt JSONL; do not write any of them
Verify ledger hash chain, registry schema, ledger head and entry-count parity
Detect registry.pending publication and outstanding ledger or receipt process locks without deleting either
Validate receipt journal chain and cross-compare receipt anchor sequence/head against indexed ledger history
Detect a receipt that claims a later registry revocation epoch than available locally
Detect receipt anchor predecessor breaks and nonmonotonic signed history, including post hoc tampering
Rehash all three byte snapshots after read; refuse changed-during-inspection snapshots
Export machine-readable incident record without any repair/recovery/ACT authority
limitations: Read-only inspection is not an atomic three-file snapshot; concurrent change checks are best-effort
An attacker who controls and rewinds all local stores can still fabricate coherent local state absent independent remote anchors
Receipt anchor claims are documentary; real external custody signatures are not authenticated by this module
No automatic file repair, orphan lock takeover, distributed fencing or incident closure
No authenticated original physical capture or independent remote receipt
